original_source: UCI Machine Learning Repository (Pima Indians Diabetes Database); the dataset is no longer listed on the current UCI site
original_owner: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK)
donor: Vincent Sigillito, Applied Physics Laboratory, The Johns Hopkins University (1990)
citation: Smith, J.W., Everhart, J.E., Dickson, W.C., Knowler, W.C., & Johannes, R.S. (1988). Using the ADAP learning algorithm to forecast the onset of diabetes mellitus. Proc. Symposium on Computer Applications and Medical Care, 261-265.
population: Females aged >= 21 years of Pima Indian heritage living near Phoenix, Arizona, USA
label_definition: tested_positive = signs of diabetes by WHO criteria (2-h post-load plasma glucose >= 200 mg/dL at a survey examination, or found during routine medical care)
